scope_reviewed: Protocol and runner only. No workbook payloads read; no runner execution; no shared state edited.

findings.issue: The per-sheet row cap is checked against ws.max_row before iteration, but the entire worksheet is then materialized into a Python list before actual yielded row count is bounded. A workbook with understated worksheet dimensions can exceed max_rows_per_sheet and max_total_rows during materialization; the total-row check occurs only later while processing rows.
findings.consequence: The declared row budget is not an effective pre-allocation guard and may permit substantial memory use before fail-stop. The fixed archive hash limits source identity, but does not make this configured bound enforceable for parser-observed rows.
findings.minimal_resolution: Iterate rows incrementally and enforce actual per-sheet and cumulative row limits as rows are yielded, while retaining only bounded header/sample state needed for processing. Keep the existing no-retry stop behavior and other caps.
findings.effect_on_go: Do not issue ROOT_READ_GO until the row budget guard is corrected and runner hash is refreshed/reviewed.

qualifications.issue: The output boundary list covers the 23 transitions among the newly read 24 files. The reused first-file summary has no complete last actual Date_Time, so the transition from that saved first-file summary to the first newly read file cannot have a verified wall-time gap.
qualifications.handling: Mark that initial wall-time boundary UNVERIFIED in the resulting summary or handoff; do not reread the first-file payload. This does not block the requested descriptive unmapped occurrence series and conveys no native-cycle, RUL, or EOL readiness.

gates.aggregate_member_read_budget: bounded by 24-member manifest and 50MB protocol cap
gates.no_firstfile_payload_reread: summary hash reused; no first-file payload read is coded
gates.model_fit_inference_eol_creation: zero/false in protocol and no such operations coded
gates.cell_reads: no cell 37/38 or other-cell payload reads coded
gates.lock_and_owner_gate: nonblocking lock and GO owner match are present
gates.one_shot_claim: exclusive create before data work prevents a second claim

causal_and_scope_review.descriptive_only: No model, fit, prediction, normalization, or EOL label creation is coded.
causal_and_scope_review.occurrence_handling: Contiguous source-cycle occurrences are retained per file and file boundaries are emitted separately; no cross-file merge or cycle renumbering.
causal_and_scope_review.time_and_samples: Actual Date_Time is retained per sample for occurrence boundaries; Test_Time is required nondecreasing within each file; nonfinite numeric samples stop.
causal_and_scope_review.capacity_semantics: Discharge counter and adjacent-negative-sample partial integral are labeled as descriptive diagnostics; limitations explicitly deny complete-capacity/EOL qualification.
